construction_path_change: CHANGE since the issue was filed (2026-07-28): the production `new P2PDraftHost(...)` call in client/src/adapter/draftPodHostAdapter.ts:312 (file created 2026-09-17, commit 12a8ef4a) now passes `config.backupEndpoint` as the 12th constructor argument, and the constructor stores it as `this.backupEndpoint = backupEndpoint ?? null`. The endpoint derives from the user's configured hosting server via `configuredBackupEndpoint()` in client/src/stores/draftPodStore.ts:49-55 (websocket URL -> http(s) origin). So blocker #1 from the issue ('the only production new P2PDraftHost(...) call does not pass backupEndpoint') no longer holds when a hosting server is configured; the upload branch CAN now be entered.
